summary: 48-hour in-person hackathon at Hype Areena, Espoo, Finland with partner challenge tracks and a new Arduino hardware lab for physical AI and robotics.
eligibility: Open to builders aged 18+ of any background, solo or in teams of up to 4. Acceptance required; invitation letters for visas are issued to accepted international participants. Travel grant window has closed.
title: Junction 2026

prize.description: EUR 100,000 in prizes; full breakdown not yet published.

notes: Event runs 13–15 November 2026. Entry is free for accepted participants.
